correctness.rationale: The invertible Newton identities identify the ideal with the first m elementary symmetric generators, a regular sequence by the standard finite freeness over the symmetric subring. Thus the dimension and degree are as claimed. The Vandermonde rank calculation remains valid in the projective charts: Euler's identity on the zero locus makes the radial direction lie in the kernel. At a rank-deficient point the first r equations for the r distinct nonzero values force every such integer multiplicity to vanish modulo p. This rules out deficiency for n
